text: Or the earthquake, and so we have pure device-to-device communication. But as mentioned already, there are other cases where we may have a hybrid network that includes both these devices that communicate with each other directly, plus a piece of infrastructure. And this hybrid case indeed is when this piece of infrastructure then acts as a gateway toward the internet. Here you have a list of possible applications for these kind of network systems. So we may have personal communications, and this is easy to realize. I think it's when us as users have different devices and they need to be connected with each other. Right? So we might have a laptop, the keyboard, external keyboard that is wirelessly connected with the laptop, the mouse that is wirelessly connected with the laptop. We may have a communication between the laptop again wirelessly connected to a larger screen. We may have the phone connected with the laptop, earphones connected with the phone. So all these devices that are in close proximity of a user may be indeed connected through these kind of wireless communication links. The other example is Internet of Things, where actually our things are typically intended as sensors.
